subject: math
description: Apply AA similarity in diagrams by using two pairs of equal angles to justify that two triangles are similar.
learningObjectives: State the AA similarity criterion for triangles
Identify two pairs of corresponding congruent angles in a diagram
Match corresponding vertices before writing a triangle similarity statement
Use parallel-line angle relationships as evidence for AA similarity
Justify triangle similarity from angle information in a short proof chain
Recognize when angle information is not enough to prove AA similarity
prerequisites: Name triangles and angles from a diagram
Use corresponding, alternate interior, and vertical angle relationships
Understand that similar figures have the same shape
Read parallel-line marks and congruent angle marks
